title: Nearly 2 Months Into Developing OVERDRIVE, Here's How Far It's Come!
author: ProfMags
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm officially approaching the **2 month milestone** of developing my game, **OVERDRIVE!**

Since my last update, I've made a ton of progress! I've been working heavily on the game's first proper map, improving animations, VFX, post-processing effects, and overall performance. I've also spent a significant amount of time overhauling the enemy AI to make enemies smarter, more challenging, and much more engaging to fight.

I've added a bunch of smaller visual effects and details throughout the game, which I think really help bring everything together. I've honestly had a blast working on it this past week alone, and I'm hoping to have a playable demo of the first map ready within another month!

The first map currently features **8 purchasable areas, 13 different weapons to buy, multiple traps that players can activate using in-game currency, and 2 minibosses so far!** I took a lot of inspiration from *Transformers: War for Cybertron* and *Call of Duty Zombies*, especially when it comes to the map design, progression, and overall gameplay experience.

For anyone curious about how I've been developing the game, I've been using **Claude Opus 5.5** primarily for VFX, environmental assets, and visual improvements. For the character models, I used **Codex** to generate reference images, **Tripo** to turn those references into 3D meshes, and then **Opus 5.5** to clean up the models, fix topology and texture issues, and reduce triangle counts while preserving their overall detail and quality.

I've personally worked on the majority of the actual gameplay mechanics and systems. I'm much more of a programmer than an artist, so AI has been incredibly helpful in bringing the visual side of the game to life, lol.

There's still a lot of work ahead, but seeing how far OVERDRIVE has come in just under two months has been incredibly exciting. I'm really looking forward to sharing more progress and hopefully getting a playable demo into people's hands soon!
